defect: Proof 2.1 placed an extra pressure norm on the right side after describing the supremum as already divided by that norm.
repair: State the unnormalized supremum lower bound explicitly, then divide by the positive pressure norm before the infimum.
verified_argument: For nonzero q, v=-B_Dq is nonzero because its divergence is -q. Its numerator is ||q||² and its velocity norm is at most C_div||q||. Thus the unnormalized supremum is at least ||q||/C_div, and the normalized inf-sup lower bound is 1/C_div.
consumer_effect: The public continuous inf-sup conclusion is unchanged; its mini-element consumer uses exactly the same lower bound.
checks: No tests, validators, hashing, contract or metadata changes performed. Root owns current checks and packet rebinding.
